name: Riverwoods Development Grant
summary: Grants of up to £20,000 in Scotland to scope, plan and design river woodland creation and restoration, producing a development plan that comes before field delivery. Charities, community groups and local bodies apply; round two closes on 1 December 2026.

status.quote: We are currently accepting new applications for the Riverwoods Development Grant.

deadline.quote: The deadline for completed applications is 12 noon on 1 December 2026.

pool.quote: In total, £250,000 is available for Round Two.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants should be based in Scotland and be one of the following: ENGO Charitable Trust/Organisation Constituted Community Group/ Voluntary Group / Foundation Environmentally focussed not for profit organisation Local public bodies including Local Authorities and District Salmon Fisheries Boards

geography.quote: Applicants should be based in Scotland and be one of the following

access.quote: The Application Form must be completed in full (either in Word or PDF format) and submitted

window.quote: a second round of funding has been made available

amount.quote: Applicants can apply for up to £20,000. Funding requests are expected to be within the £10,000-£20,000 range.
